verdict.rationale: The evidence says Firecrawl is open source under AGPL-3.0 and also offered as a hosted service, but nothing documents a Docker image, container deployment, or production self-hosting guidance. Open-source availability is only a building block a developer could use to construct their own deployment, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy the scraping service via a Docker container for production use
